Name: Peskit's Wallpapers and Floors
Author: Azcari
Description:
[font=Verdana]This mod aims to expand your available amount of floors and wallpapers to a more respectable amount.
All assets and patterns used can be found throughout the vanilla game either exactly as they are or with different colors.

Right now this mod features a total of [b]136 floors and 192 wallpapers[/b].
Don't freak out right now, some wallpapers are listed more than once and only had their baseboard changed to better match your floor.

They all are grouped and although the names seem long I tried to add as many and less as possible catchy words so you can find similar ones as well. The name always start with the main group - what is it made of or what is the most obvious feature.

[b]Some examples for groups/categories
[/b][color=#93c47d]Main Groups[/color]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana]Wood[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Stone[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Carpet[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Abstract[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Classic[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]...[/font]
[/list]
[color=#93c47d]A few Subcategories[/color]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana]Slim[/font]
[*]Vertical
[*]Horizontal
[*]Diagonal
[*][i]Color names[/i]
[*]Simple
[*]Striped
[*]Checkered
[*]Baseboard
[*]...
[/list]

I only upload on Nexusmods.com and do not approve of uploads on other sites without my permission.

[/font][font=Verdana][center][s]~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~[/s][/center][/font][font=Verdana]
How to install:
You need Alternative Textures and SMAPI for this to work.
1. Download
2. Unzip
3. Paste into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

The Mod was successfully tested with SMAPI 3.13.4, AT 5.0.7 and SDV 1.5.6

[/font][font=Verdana][s][center]~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~[/center]

[/s]The first version of this Mod was for Content Patcher and is still available.
I won't replace x floor with AT version floor y. Same with updates unless the mod utterly breaks after a CP update and I get notified about it.
